package_info.package_versions: Affected versions prior to patched release (e.g., 3.2.2, 4.0, etc.)
package_info.why_malicious: The package contains a critical vulnerability that allows for remote code execution (RCE) when deserializing untrusted data. Attackers can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on affected systems, making the use of vulnerable versions of this package highly dangerous.

execution_context.file_location: Java application code using commons-collections (e.g., via ObjectInputStream or similar deserialization APIs)
required_permissions: network (if deserialization is triggered by remote input)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(inputStream);
Object obj = ois.readObject();
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Deserializes an object from an input stream. If the input contains a crafted payload exploiting the commons-collections vulnerability, this can trigger arbitrary code execution.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Deserializing untrusted data using vulnerable versions of commons-collections can lead to RCE. Attackers can supply malicious serialized objects that exploit gadget chains in the library.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal behavior expects deserialization to reconstruct safe, trusted objects. In this case, deserialization can execute attacker-controlled code.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Deserialization is legitimate when used with trusted data sources and safe object types.
key_indicators: No input validation or class whitelisting

attack_chain.action: Attacker sends a crafted serialized payload to the application (e.g., via HTTP request, file upload, etc.)
attack_chain.leads_to: Application receives and processes the payload

attack_chain.action: Application deserializes the untrusted payload using ObjectInputStream and vulnerable commons-collections classes
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of attacker-controlled code on the server

attack_chain.action: Attacker gains remote code execution on the target system
attack_chain.leads_to: Compromise of application and potential lateral movement

behavioral_signatures: Loading of commons-collections gadget classes during deserialization
Unexpected process execution or network activity following deserialization
file_indicators: Presence of commons-collections-*.jar in application dependencies
Application code invoking ObjectInputStream.readObject() on untrusted sources
network_indicators: Inbound requests containing serialized Java objects
Outbound connections or callbacks triggered immediately after deserialization
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor application code and runtime for deserialization of untrusted data, especially when using vulnerable versions of commons-collections. Use static analysis to identify code paths that deserialize data from external sources. Monitor for loading of known gadget classes and unexpected process or network activity following deserialization events. Flag applications bundling vulnerable commons-collections versions for immediate review and patching.
